verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for an AI code-review platform, for example periodic codebase scans, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only event-triggered automation (automatic reviews on new PRs, comment-triggered reviews, auto-fix) and on-demand codebase scans, with no documented way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Event-driven triggers and one-off actions do not count as a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
